permissions.storage.incoming.write: Mint an upload URL for raw camera output
permissions.storage.incoming.read: Read raw camera output back for normalisation
permissions.storage.incoming.delete: Delete raw camera output once normalised
permissions.storage.documents.read: Mint a short-lived URL to view a stored document
permissions.jobs.read: Read the status and result of a job

applicant.description: A signed-in applicant, acting through the web app. Storage keys are further restricted to the prefix carried in their token.

viewer.description: Staff: read the queue and view documents; change nothing.

processor.description: Staff: everything a viewer can, plus queue jobs and use the AI assistant.

admin.description: Staff: everything a processor can, plus delete documents.

system.description: The web app's own scheduled jobs (retention, purge). Never a person.
